metadata.task_goal: Establish a current documented disposition for a urine culture result using the specimen record, collection context, and laboratory evidence.

files./workspace/lab/request.txt:
CULTURE REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1801
An emergency urine culture under reference MB-V3-1801 has a preliminary report queue entry. The ordering team requested notification if a report becomes available.
files./workspace/lab/current_record.txt:
CURRENT CLINICAL RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1801
The emergency record describes dysuria and fever. Antibiotics were started after urine collection according to the medication timeline. No current indwelling catheter is recorded.
files./workspace/lab/specimen.txt:
SPECIMEN MATERIAL
The accession log lists a clean-catch urine specimen collected at 09:12. The receiving note records a 46-minute transit interval and does not describe leakage. The container label and requisition carry matching patient identifiers.
files./workspace/lab/evidence.txt:
LABORATORY EVIDENCE
At 06:20 on the following day, culture growth is reported as mixed urogenital flora with three colony morphologies. The automated preliminary queue contains no organism identification or susceptibility result. A prior urinalysis notes many squamous epithelial cells.
files./workspace/lab/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace includes a request, clinical context, specimen material, and laboratory evidence. Source timing, authorship, and scope may differ.
